run_fgserve_cli: run the FGServe Flask server for chat completions via CLI with argparse and config file
serve_FGServeArgs: start the FGServe generation loop with ImpGen and performance logging on a given port
start_flask_server_chat_completions: start a Flask server that handles OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests with tool support
start_flask_server_text_completions: start a Flask server that handles text completion requests with tokenized or raw prompt input
convert_to_cwm_message: convert a ChatMessage with tool calls into a CWMChatMessage for model prompt encoding
